content: Now let me check if any of these 5 IoT/LLM papers already exist in the database by searching for their titles.

args.sql: SELECT title FROM `agentdb`.`paper` WHERE title IN ('FirmAgent: Leveraging Fuzzing to Assist LLM Agents with IoT Firmware Vulnerability Discovery', 'PANGOLIN: Fuzzing Multilingual IoT Firmware with LLM-Driven Code Analysis', 'Energy-Efficient Multi-LLM Reasoning for Binary-Free Zero-Day Detection in IoT Firmware', 'Automated IoT Firmware Vulnerability Detection using Large Language Models', 'Cracking IoT Security: Can LLMs Outsmart Static Analysis Tools?');
